newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 2.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 2.

text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- An armed Latvian amry private who deserted at the week-end was arrested after a shoot-out with authorities.
- The Prosecutor's office has asked Germany to extradite Armands Stendzenieks, manager of the German-registed Zus Trading Rohstoff GmbH, who failed to return $18 million to Banka Baltija.
- Seven Latvian companies participate in the World Food Fair Moscow.
- The Dave Brubeck Jazz Quartet, currently on an East European tour, gives a concert in the Riga opera house today.
